description: This file implements a fuzzed socket class used for testing network socket behavior with randomized inputs, errors, and asynchronous operations within the Chromium project.

classes.name: FuzzedSocket
classes.description: A mock socket class for fuzz testing network code by simulating socket operations with randomized data and errors.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Simulates reading data from the socket, either synchronously or asynchronously, with randomized data or errors.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Simulates writing data to the socket, either synchronously or asynchronously, with randomized data or errors.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Simulates establishing a connection, with randomized success or failure, synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Resets the socket state, simulating a disconnection.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote address of the socket if connected.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket if connected.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: ConsumeReadWriteErrorFromData
methods.description: Selects a socket error code from predefined error arrays.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an asynchronous read operation.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an asynchronous write operation.

methods.name: OnConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an asynchronous connect operation.

methods.name: ForceSync
methods.description: Determines if subsequent operations should be forced to be synchronous based on the number of async operations performed.
